name: April 10, 2025 Special Meeting Work Session - Notice of Adjournment
agenda_text:
Notice of Adjournment
  Malibu City Council
  Work Session
  Special Meeting

Please take notice that the Special City Council Meeting of Thursday, April 10, 2025
at 3:00 p.m., is hereby adjourned to Thursday, April 24, 2025 at 3:00 p.m.

The Adjourned Special meeting will be held in the Multi-Purpose Room at City Hall,
23825 Stuart Ranch Road, Malibu, California 90265.

Should there be any questions regarding this notice, please contact the City Clerk’s
Office at cityclerk@malibucity.org, or (310) 456-2489 ext. 228.

Dated: April 11, 2025 at 11:15 a.m.

__________________________________
Kelsey Pettijohn, City Clerk
